headline: Subex wins contract for HyperSense fraud management in Africa
hook: Subex secures new African telecom contract
summary: Subex Limited has signed a deal with a major African mobile network operator to deploy its HyperSense Fraud Management solutions. This contract involves implementing AI-driven tools to detect and mitigate telecommunications fraud. The deal expands the company's footprint in the African market. For retail investors, this represents a fresh order win that may impact the company's revenue growth in the upcoming quarters.
why_it_matters: New order wins support revenue visibility for Subex shareholders.

headline: Subex issues regulatory depository certificate for September quarter
summary: Subex Limited has submitted the mandatory compliance certificate under Regulation 74(5) of the SEBI Depositories and Participants Regulations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. This statutory filing confirms the dematerialisation and rematerialisation of securities during the period. It is a routine administrative requirement for listed companies and has no direct financial impact on the company's earnings. Indian retail investors holding the stock need not take any action as this is standard regulatory paperwork.
why_it_matters: Purely administrative filing with zero impact on stock price
